name: Celestial armor
description: celestial armor of polished black silver: two sculpted domed plates of ornate pierced filigree that fully cover each breast, joined at the centre by a jewelled ornament set with a pale moonstone gem, and a matching ornate hip piece with a hanging front panel and a curved plate at each hip, every surface engraved with a night sky of crescent moons, constellations and small moth wings; each piece hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and floating freely; midriff, shoulders and arms bare
notes: Necromancer / Darkness. Signature earned armor: filigree plates fully covering the bust and hips, held by magic, motif drawn from her class and element.
